## Notes

- Commonwealth Production System (SPI 20.78): three tables on one page of the Commonwealth chart set (jp2 140). A: one die per truck type each turn, points arrive four turns later, at most a quarter of them at Alexandria, the later column reflects Lend-Lease. B: two dice per turn for infantry replacement points by the game-turn band of the turn planned for (arriving four turns later, all in one city). C: every other replacement type — lifetime total, the cap per turn / month / fortnight and the first (and last) turn it may be planned for; the Tiger convoy is extra
- Item slugs are ours; 'armoured-recce' is the chart's Armored Recce / Armored Car line. 'none' on the infantry table is stored as 0
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Commonwealth Charts.pdf:p30): 0 of 36 truck cells, 0 of 44 infantry cells and 0 of 24 chart rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
